title: Synthetic record carrying unsafe and ordinary markdown links
foundBy: fixture author, for the viewer's link-safety check
details: This record exists so the fixture suite can watch what the markdown viewer does with link schemes. It names [the safe link](https://example.com/sandbox/spec) next to [the js link](javascript:alert(1)) and [the data link](data:text/html;base64,PHQ+PGk+dW5zYWZlPC9pPjwvdD4=) on purpose: the first must keep its href, the other two must lose theirs.
